decision: Ship phase 1 of opengrid in this run and track phase 2 and 3 in ROADMAP.md
why: The request says to deliver the client-side grid now, not stop after a plan

decision: Keep one grid session that owns columns, the view, and the canvas
why: Sort, filter, and paint share one row order. Two writers on those files would race

decision: Match AG Grid 36.2.0 null order, case-sensitive sort, case-insensitive text filters, exclusive inRange, and quoted CRLF CSV
why: A happy-dom probe of the public package showed those results

decision: Store each column as a typed array plus a null bitmap, and keep the visible order as a Uint32 index
why: The hot path reads one column. Row objects stay for the public node.data contract

decision: Run sort and filter in a worker above 32768 rows, and share numeric arrays when the page is cross-origin isolated
why: The sort target is off the main thread. SharedArrayBuffer avoids a second copy of the numbers

decision: Report first render separately from worker startup, and do not claim a heap win
why: performance.memory did not move, and worker wait is about 15 ms after firstDataRendered

decision: Draw cells on a canvas and keep headers, editors, and element cell renderers in the DOM
why: Custom renderers and screen readers need elements. The 1M scroll stays at one frame

decision: Keep the review flags that are still open
why: A second model read the trail. Large sorts finish on modelUpdated, the package is TypeScript bundled by Vite, heap delta was not measured, and the bench checks order on the first 400 rows

decision: Publish dist/index.js and dist/worker.js, and point the package entry there
why: A variable worker URL is invisible to bundlers, and shipping only TypeScript left the worker out of a real build

decision: Add applyTransaction plus cellStyle and cellClass
why: Those were accepted by the types and then ignored

decision: Compare sort and filter samples with AG Grid across the row range, and test a 40000 row worker sort in the browser
why: A count match and the first 400 rows did not show which rows moved

decision: Put the Vite demo on Cloudflare Pages project opengrid
why: Grok Pages cannot host the Vite app, and the earlier workers.dev preview was temporary

decision: Continue parity from the previous run and add community behavior that ag-grid-community 36.2.0 can check
why: The operator asked for every AG Grid feature under poteto-mode. Rows before this one are the earlier run

decision: Treat done as the same observable result as ag-grid-community 36.2.0 on each community call, and as the public doc for enterprise calls
why: Enterprise is not in the installed package, so a side-by-side check cannot cover it yet

decision: Match quick filter as case-insensitive words that all have to hit the same row, then AND that with the column filter
why: A happy-dom probe of 36.2.0 returned those ids, including "bo 10" and "2020" inside a formatted date

decision: Keep getDisplayedRowCount as the full filtered count and move only the painted window
why: The same probe kept six row nodes while first and last displayed indexes followed the page

decision: Round-trip sort, filter, column order, width, pin, hide, page, and selected row ids
why: getState from 36.2.0 matched after dropping the version string

decision: Keep a quick filter match inside a hidden column, because 36.2.0 still returned Nora after name was hidden
why: A second model said the default skips hidden columns. The compat call showed a and b on both sides only when the hidden name column stayed searchable. isColumnFilterPresent stays false for a quick filter alone, getState copies the filter model, and column width is a number

decision: Typecheck and the compat suite pass after those fixes
why: npx tsc -p packages/opengrid/tsconfig.json --noEmit and npx vitest run both exited 0

decision: Load the same infinite blocks as ag-grid-community 36.2.0, including the sort refetch and purge cache keys
why: A happy-dom test waited for AG Grid's deferred getRows and compared the call list and displayed ids

decision: Move a managed row drag so the gripped row lands before the row under the pointer
why: happy-dom did not fire ag-grid drag events, so the order was checked on opengrid only

decision: AgGridVue mounts createGrid, emits grid-ready, and pushes a new rowData into setGridOption
why: packages/opengrid-vue/src/vue.test.ts passed and the package typecheck exited 0

decision: AgGridAngular creates the grid from inputs and applies a later rowData change through setGridOption
why: packages/opengrid-angular/src/angular.test.ts passed and the package typecheck exited 0

decision: Group client-side rows into an auto column, expand with setExpanded, and switch columns with setRowGroupColumns
why: Enterprise is not installed, so the check is the group test, not a side-by-side run

decision: Put sum, min, max, count, and avg of the child leaves on the group row aggData
why: The group test checks Ireland sales 4 plus 9 equals 13 and the qty average is 2

decision: Build one column per pivot key and store that key's aggregate on the group row
why: The pivot test checks Ireland 2020 sales is 4 and 2021 sales is 9

decision: Nest rows from getDataPath and collapse a branch with setExpanded
why: The tree test shows CEO, Sales, EU, and Support, then hides EU when Sales is collapsed

decision: Insert a detail row under an expanded master and ignore a row isRowMaster rejects
why: The detail test shows note a between a and b, and b stays closed
